resources.string: Android only lets the app start from the background on the train if it is exempt from battery optimisation. Without it you get a “Train Wi-Fi detected” notification to tap instead.
Armed. Nothing runs until a Wi-Fi network appears; then the portal is probed and the trip card starts only on a train.
Train Wi-Fi SSIDs, one per line (open networks)
Press “Enable auto-connect”, approve the Wi-Fi suggestions and the background start, then forget about it: the app wakes up on the train and sleeps in between.
Posts the card on a non-silent channel with sound off, so Android keeps it on the lock screen.
Same information, default importance without sound so it stays visible on the lock screen
Ongoing train Wi-Fi and trip information
